long_description: Anana is an AI workspace for hospitality commercial teams. It connects bookings, calls, chats, emails, market intelligence, and hotel knowledge so teams can see demand earlier, understand what is driving it, and take action in the tools they already use. Built for hotel groups and management companies, Anana gives revenue, sales, marketing, and operations teams one place to work from the same commercial context.
name: Anana
one_liner: AI Workspace for Hospitality Commercial Teams
